title: Advances of deep learning based ultrasonic nondestructive testing for CFRP structures: a review

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Advances of deep learning based ultrasonic nondestructive testing for CFRP structures: a review》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Carbon fiber reinforced polymers (CFRP) exhibit exceptional properties such as low density, high strength, corrosion resistance, and design flexibility, making them widely employed in aerospace, automotive, and biomedical applications.

evidence.text: Carbon fiber reinforced polymers (CFRP) exhibit exceptional properties such as low density, high strength, corrosion resistance, and design flexibility, making them widely employed in aerospace, automotive, and biomedical applications.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Advances of deep learning based ultrasonic nondestructive testing for CFRP structures: a review》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】This paper provides a comprehensive review of recent advances in DL-UNDT for CFRP structures, summarizes key developments across damage detection, localization, and imaging tasks, and discusses prospective research directions for addressing current challenges.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Advances of deep learning based ultrasonic nondestructive testing for CFRP structures: a review》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Ultrasonic NDT (UNDT) offers long-range detection, high sensitivity, and cost efficiency for damage evaluation, yet conventional UNDT methods rely heavily on expert interpretation and manual analysis, which limits their accuracy and efficiency.
